newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX Hub natgas seen lower on technical pressure.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX Hub natgas seen lower on technical pressure.

text.p: NYMEX Henry Hub natgas futures were expected to open lower Monday under some technical pressure and reports of lower physical gas prices, industry sources said.
In early over the counter acitivity, July Henry Hub gas was pegged at $2.21-2.22 per million British thermal units (mmBtu), down from Friday's NYMEX Henry Hub July close at $2.239 per mmBtu.
"The market seems to be more technically led than anything else right now," said one futures trader.

The NYMEX natgas futures ended mixed Friday in a sluggish, post-bidweek session, with front months, hit by technical selling and reports of softer cash, again unable to get above unchanged, sources said.
Some areas of support were seen for the July contract in the $2.17-2.19 per mmBtu range, the sources said.
Cool weather through much of the eastern portion of the continent this week was expected to mean minimal air conditioning demand, sources said.
